messages:
Maria (CSM): Quick sync — Acme's usage spiked yesterday; they're approaching the 95th-percentile token quota. Thinking we should proactively increase their monthly soft quota from 500M -> 750M for the next billing cycle and send a heads-up. Anyone see issues with that?
Jon (Eng): I saw the spike, latency hasn't changed much but error rate bumped 0.4% at peak. Scaling should be fine. Need 24h lead to apply reserved quota in Dedicated pools.
Alex (Support): +1 on comms. Can we include the ETA, expected cost delta, and a note on fallback behavior if we hit hard limits? I'll prep the ticket template.
Maria (CSM): Thanks. Sam can you confirm spend approval from account side? @Sam (AE)
Sam (AE): Yup, spoke with their finance lead — small increase is acceptable if we include estimated costs. They prefer monthly caps not hard stops.
QuotaBot: [system] Quota increase request created — ticket #Q-4912. Current status: pending approval.
Jon (Eng): For the Dedicated change the ops run is `apply_quota --team acme --limit 750000000` (will require a config roll). ETA 24–36h after approval.
Alex (Support): Draft of the comms below — please review:

``
Hi Acme team,

We're proactively increasing your monthly soft quota to 750M tokens to avoid service interruptions after recent usage spikes. Expected cost increase: ~$1,200/month. If you'd prefer a hard cap instead, let us know. This change will be applied within 24–36 hours after your confirmation.

— Maria, Redwood CSM
```

Maria (CSM): Edited the wording for clarity, removed pricing line (we'll send cost in a separate billing note). New draft attached in thread.
Sam (AE): Approving the change now. Please proceed with Q-4912.
QuotaBot: [system] Ticket Q-4912 status updated: approved by Sam (AE).
Jon (Eng): Kicking off the apply job now. I'll post logs here when done.
Jon (Eng): apply_quota job started on infra-03. Rolling config.
Jon (Eng): Done — quota applied. Verified on monitoring: Acme soft quota = 750M. No errors during rollout. :white_check_mark:
Maria (CSM): Great — Alex, please send the comms, omit price, include rollback steps and contact link. I'll follow up in the weekly account health check.
Alex (Support): Will do now. Tagging the ticket Q-4912 and closing the loop. :thumbsup:
